_doc: Revisão do inglês dos diálogos (fala mais natural, menos 'de dicionário'). fix: inglês antigo -> novo (vale para a tabela de tradução da história, narrações das fases, legendas do vídeo, textos do jogo e falas do herói). add: falas que não tinham inglês (português -> inglês). Aplicado por scripts/patch_en_dialogue.py; a dublagem em inglês usa o mesmo arquivo (scripts/build_voice_dub.py).

fix.So you crossed the mist. Few make it thi: So you made it through the mist. Not many get this far.
fix.Before you ever knew the Depths, they al: Long before you knew the Depths, they knew you.
fix.This forest hides the way to the DepthGa: This forest hides the way to the DepthGates — open wounds in the world, and they're waking up.
fix.At the heart of the woods lies an ancien: There's an ancient seal at the heart of these woods. To break it, you'll need the Emerald Crystals hidden in the far clearings.
fix.Find them. I will be waiting at the Hear: Find them. I'll be waiting for you at the Heart of the Forest.
You made it. These are the DepthGates.
fix.Each gate leads to a land consumed by th: Every gate leads to a land the Depths have swallowed, and every one of them guards a seal — an ancient crystal.
fix.Bring the seals to me. With them, I can: Bring me the seals. With them, I can close these wounds.
fix.The order does not matter. Choose whiche: The order doesn't matter. Go wherever your heart pulls you.
Every last seal… after all this time.
The gate to Valdrak Castle is awake. The King is in there — and so is the thing living inside him.
fix.Go. Please. Do not make me wait another: Go. Please. Don't make me wait another hundred years.
fix.Not much longer. I can feel the castle b: Not much longer now. I can feel the castle breathing.
fix.When the last seal is in my hands, you w: Once the last seal is in my hands, it'll all make sense. I promise.
fix.Have you heard a voice in your dreams? A: Have you been hearing a voice in your dreams? A king begging for help?
fix.Do not listen. The Depths imitate those: Don't listen to it. The Depths wear the voices of the people we love.
You saw the empty tombs in there, didn't you? The Ancients never died…
…they ran. Don't ask me how I know.
fix.One seal at a time. I can feel the wound: One seal at a time. I can feel the wound starting to close.
fix.He uses my eyes. My hands. But my name…: He uses my eyes. My hands. But my name… that, he couldn't take.
fix.She is lying to you. She always knew wha: She's lying to you. She's always known what the seals really are.
fix.The Emerald Crystals lie in the farthest: The Emerald Crystals are out in the farthest clearings. Bring them to the Heart of the Forest.
That's a lot of questions for someone so young. Go. The answers are on the other side.
fix.The seals were screaming inside me. I wa: The seals were screaming inside my head. That wasn't me… I swear.
fix.I beg you… let me live. Let me mend what: I'm begging you… let me live. Let me fix what I've done.
fix.Lower your weapon. The hunger is gone —: Put your weapon down. The hunger's gone — look at her eyes.
fix.No one else dies for these gates. She wi: No one else dies for these gates. She'll guard them with me… the way it should've been from the start.
fix.Thank you… Aelric… I only wanted you bac: Thank you… Aelric… I just wanted you back.
fix.Am I… free? No. He is still in here. I f: Am I… free? No. He's still in here. I can feel his eyes behind mine.
Aelric! I knew you were still in there.
fix.Hero, you deserve the truth. My name is: You deserve the truth. My name is Elyndra. I was the Queen of Valdrak.
fix.The seals you brought me did not close w: The seals you brought me never closed any wounds. They were the chains of a prison — and I needed it weak enough to rip the Observer out of him.
fix.ELYNDRA… you brought me a new body… and: ELYNDRA… you brought me a new body… and an entire world…
fix.Listen to neither of us. Seal the prison: Don't listen to either of us. Seal the prison again — even if I go down with it.
fix.No! The crystals can tear him out. Trust: No! The crystals can still tear him out. Trust me — one last time.
fix.The sand swallowed the old sanctuary of: The sand swallowed the old Sanctuary of Light whole — only the pyramid still reaches for the sky.
fix.Before his corruption, Lord Valdrak pray: Before the corruption took him, Lord Valdrak used to pray there, deep in the desert.
fix.Now a lava golem stirs beneath the pyram: Now a lava golem stirs beneath the pyramid, and the souls of cultists wander the dunes.
fix.The Lava Golem crumbles into glassy sand: The Lava Golem crumbles into sand that shines like glass.
fix.The Sacred Desert Crystal glows in your: The Sacred Desert Crystal blazes in your hand, and somewhere far away, the dark wards of Valdrak Castle shatter.
fix.The forest here is older than any kingdo: This forest is older than any kingdom.
The rivers whisper names in Tupi.
fix.Something with horns and eyes of fire gu: Something with horns and burning eyes watches over the souls of this forest: the Anhangá.
fix.Flagless boats left marks on the stones: Boats without flags left their marks on the rocks of these isles.
fix.Someone was here before you — and did no: Someone got here before you — and they didn't come to close any gates.
fix.The wind carries the cry of an enormous: The wind carries the cry of something huge — some kind of bird.
Here, not even the dead get to rest.
fix.A woman's voice commands the bones among: Among the dead trees, a woman's voice gives orders to the bones.
fix.The whispers always repeat the same phra: The whispers keep repeating the same words.
fix.The castle of a king who opened the door: This is the castle of a king who opened the doors to save his people.
fix.Up above, someone watches your every ste: From somewhere above, something is watching every step you take.
fix.You wounded it... but you did not defeat: You hurt it... but you didn't beat it.
fix.The dragon took to the skies, leaving a: The dragon takes to the sky, trailing ash across the woods.
fix.Wherever this journey ends — it will be: Wherever this journey ends — it'll be there, waiting.
fix.The gates kept a seal down here, among t: The gates hid a seal down here, among the dead.
fix.They say the Ancients were buried in the: They say the Ancients were laid to rest in these catacombs.
fix.The seal of the Catacombs is within reac: The Catacombs' seal is within reach.
This place isn't on any map.
fix.The stones bear a crest worn down by tim: The stones carry a crest that time has nearly worn away.
fix.Someone forged something here they never: Someone forged something here that was never meant to be opened.
Another seal slips free of its chains.
fix.Someone froze this place on purpose, so: Someone froze this place on purpose, so nothing here would ever thaw.
fix.On the walls, a circle of gates drawn in: Scratched into the ice on the walls: a circle of gates.
The ice around the seal splinters.
fix.The portal opened on the flank of a volc: The portal opens on the side of a volcano that never really went to sleep.
fix.Ash falls like dark snow, and rivers of: Ash falls like black snow, and rivers of lava have carved the rock into bottomless chasms.
fix.High above, in the caldera, ash-pale win: High up in the caldera, wings pale as ash blot out the glow of the lava.
fix.The Pale Dragon falls upon its own ashes: The Pale Dragon crashes down into its own ashes.
fix.The Magma Crystal throbs in your hands,: The Magma Crystal pulses in your hands, and the seals of Valdrak Castle grow weaker.
The gate opens onto a sea of fire.
fix.There is an inscription on the walls:: There's something carved into the walls:
fix.\"As long as the dragon keeps watch, he: "As long as the dragon keeps watch, he won't wake."
fix.In the distance, a roar echoes through t: Somewhere off in the flames, a roar echoes.
fix.And the prison, for the first time in ce: And for the first time in centuries, the prison has no guard.
For centuries, we told the same story.
fix.We said the gates were doors to forgotte: We said the gates were just doors to forgotten places.
fix.We said the Ancients were destroyed by t: We said the Ancients were destroyed by the power they found.
Whatever came in… never left his eyes again.
Now the Depths are waking up.
fix.I sought those who could cross the gates: So I went looking for those who could cross the gates.
fix.Some came for answers. Some, for revenge: Some came for answers. Some came for revenge.
fix.Some, because their own secrets were hid: Some came because their own secrets were buried there.
fix.And some… because the dead asked them to: And some… because the dead asked them to.
fix.You were not chosen for being the strong: You weren't chosen because you're the strongest.
fix.You were chosen because the Depths have: You were chosen because the Depths have already touched you.
fix.(As you touch the crystal, an ancient me: (The moment you touch the crystal, an ancient memory floods your mind…)
fix.These stones were once a sacred grove. T: These stones used to be a sacred grove. The Ancients cut down the mother trees to build the gates.
fix.I can still feel the roots beneath the m: I can still feel the roots under the marble… and they're scared.
fix.The Colossus guarded the roots, not the: The Colossus was guarding the roots, not the gate. The land can finally breathe again.
fix.This ash… it is the same that fell on Sa: This ash… it's the same ash that fell on Sakurajima. My home's volcano.
fix.My clan guarded the forges of the crater: My clan guarded the forges in that crater. What came through the fire to end up here?
fix.My ancestors forged the locks in this la: My ancestors forged these locks in this lava. And they swore never to tell anyone why.
fix.I grew up in these halls. My father, Kin: I grew up in these halls. My father, King Valdrak, opened these gates to save our people.
fix.If anything of him is still left in here: If there's anything left of him in here… I'll be the one who finds it.
fix.This throne was my father's. The Depths: This was my father's throne. I won't let the Depths wear it like a crown.
fix.I trained with the bow atop Sakurajima,: I learned the bow on top of Sakurajima, shooting into the ash wind.
fix.This is not my volcano… but the ash smel: This isn't my volcano… but the ash smells just like home.
fix.The Pale Dragon guarded the crater like: The Pale Dragon guarded that crater the way you'd guard a gate. Sakurajima needs to hear about this.
fix.I was born on these isles, among smuggle: I was born on these isles, raised by smugglers. I know every cove — and these marks weren't here before.
fix.Marked stones, flagless boats… the Order: Marked stones, boats with no flags… the Order of the Threshold is real.
fix.I grew up among the dunes of Ra-Khem. Th: I grew up in the dunes of Ra-Khem. The temple mirrors never pointed down… until now.
fix.The gates are not random. They form a ci: The gates aren't random. They form a circle — and this is one of the links.
fix.The temple did not burn the darkness. It: The temple never burned the darkness away. It held it in. This isn't a door… it's a cell.
fix.The dead here whisper the same phrase:: The dead here all whisper the same thing:
fix.She commanded them in his name… now they: She gave them orders in his name… now they've gone quiet. For now.
fix.Snow that never melts, wind that cuts th: Snow that never melts, wind that cuts right through you… I'm home.
The northern wolves don't howl here anymore. Something shut them up.
fix.The Ice Golem did not hunt. It kept watc: The Ice Golem wasn't hunting. It was standing guard. The animals were running from the prison, not from it.
fix.“You talk like someone who has been in t: “You talk like someone who's been in there.”
fix.“These trails are on no map. How do you: “These trails aren't on any map. How do you know them?”
“Your cloak has the Ancients' runes on it. You can't buy that.”
fix.“The dead here fall silent when you spea: “The dead go quiet whenever you talk.”
fix.“That symbol on your staff… it is my cla: “That symbol on your staff… that's my clan's crest.”
fix.“The beasts keep away from you. Why?”: “The animals keep their distance from you. Why is that?”
fix.“Trees do not grow near you.”: “Nothing grows near you. Not even the trees.”
Seal the tombs. No one can ever know we ran.
Leave them. The names will keep the lie going.
fix.The crest goes on every lock. It is our: Put the crest on every lock. It's our signature.
fix.And if one of us wants to open them some: And if one of us ever wants to open them?
Then the family's own blood will stop him.
fix.Freeze everything. Let nothing thaw this: Freeze all of it. Nothing thaws this prison. Nothing.
fix.Your Majesty… and the King?: Your Majesty… what about the King?
fix.Guard him, old friend. As long as you ke: Watch over him, old friend. As long as you're on guard, he won't wake.
fix.And if I ever return… do not let me pass: And if I ever come back… don't let me through.
fix.Mark the stones. The Order will need the: Mark the stones. The Order's going to need the way.
fix.And if the gates awaken?: And if the gates wake up?
Keep watch over the dead, my sentinel.
fix.Aelric, don't open it! We don't know wha: Aelric, don't open it! We don't even know what he is!
fix.He promised to save the kingdom, Elyndra: He promised he'd save the kingdom, Elyndra.
fix.“You were not chosen for being the stron: “You weren't chosen because you're the strongest.”
fix.The Catacombs… the tombs of the Ancients: The Catacombs… the Ancients' tombs. They were empty, weren't they?
The Ruins carry the same symbol as the locks. Whoever forged them took their time.
fix.Eternal ice around a seal. They wanted n: Ice that never melts, wrapped around a seal. They didn't want anything thawing that prison. Ever.
fix.The dragon… it was not the monster. It w: The dragon… it wasn't the monster. It was the jailer.
fix.On the Isles, someone was building new g: Someone on the Isles was building new gates. We're not the only ones on this hunt.
fix.The dead kept repeating one phrase, didn: The dead kept saying the same thing, didn't they? “Don't let him wake.”
fix.Another seal. I can feel the wound easin: Another seal. I can feel the wound starting to close.
fix.Centuries ago, the Ancients sealed these: Centuries ago, the Ancients sealed these tombs — with nothing inside.
fix.There were no bodies. Only names, and a: There were no bodies. Just names, and a promise: “we'll come back when he sleeps.”
fix.The smiths of Valdrak forged the locks w: The smiths of Valdrak forged the locks with their own blood.
fix.The symbol carved on them was the crest: The symbol carved into them belonged to a family sworn to keep the secret.
fix.A dark-haired queen froze this seal with: A dark-haired queen froze this seal with her own tears.
fix.“Let nothing thaw this prison,” she whis: “Let nothing ever thaw this prison,” she whispered. Then she walked away without looking back.
fix.The dragon was not born a monster. It wa: The dragon wasn't born a monster. It was chained here to be the jailer.
fix.Every creature that fled from it was rea: Every creature that ran from it was really running from the prison.
fix.Flagless boats crossed the Isles at nigh: Boats with no flags slipped between the Isles at night.
fix.Men of the Order of the Threshold marked: Men from the Order of the Threshold marked the stones with the symbol of the gates.
fix.The Necromancer Queen was Valdrak's last: The Necromancer Queen was Valdrak's last sentinel.
fix.She heard the Observer whisper for three: She listened to the Observer whisper for three hundred years — until she started commanding the dead in his name.
fix.At the kingdom's edge lies a forest olde: At the edge of the kingdom lies a forest older than names. Eldervale — where the trees remember what people have forgotten.
fix.They say beneath the roots, a door sank: They say a door sank into the dark beneath its roots. And a winged shadow crosses the sky to keep it hidden.
fix.The collapse of the seals tore the fabri: When the seals collapsed, they tore through time and space... ...pulling heroes from distant eras and worlds toward one final task.
fix.Every descent into the depths begins whe: Every descent into the Depths starts where the light still touches the ground.
fix.At the kingdom's edge lies a forest olde: At the edge of the kingdom lies a forest older than names.
fix.Eldervale — where the trees keep what me: Eldervale — where the trees remember what people have forgotten.
fix.They say beneath the roots, a door sank: They say a door sank into the dark beneath its roots.
fix.And a winged shadow crosses the skies to: And a winged shadow crosses the sky to keep it hidden.

fix....converging heroes from distant eras a: ...pulling heroes from distant eras and worlds toward one final task.
fix.At the kingdom's edge, the Eldervale for: At the edge of the kingdom, the forest of Eldervale remembers what people have forgotten.
fix.Beneath its roots, a door sank into dark: Beneath its roots, a door sank into the dark.
fix.A traveler answers a call no one else ca: A traveler answers a call nobody else can hear…
fix.Every descent begins where light still t: Every descent starts where the light still touches the ground.

Online rankings aren't available.
Can't reach the server.
fix.No one has completed today's challenge y: Nobody has beaten today's challenge yet.
fix.Welcome to the Refuge! The FOREST sign t: Welcome to the Refuge! Follow the FOREST sign to head back.
fix.Welcome to the Refuge. Explore the villa: Welcome to the Refuge. Have a look around the village!
Your campaign progress has been saved.
Fine goods, paid for with your campaign gold.
fix.Locked. The tanner keeps his hides insid: Locked. The tanner keeps his hides in there.
The heat nearly singes your eyebrows off.
fix.Well-balanced blades. None for sale… yet: Nicely balanced blades. Not for sale… yet.
fix.The water still hisses from the last que: The water's still hissing from the last quench.
Ah, a customer! Come on over.
fix.The master is inside. He forges better w: The master's inside. Pay him a compliment — he forges better that way.
fix.Abyssal fragments make good steel. Bring: Abyss fragments make great steel. Bring lots!
fix.Tried fusing items? Ask at the BARGAINS: Ever tried fusing items? Ask over at the BARGAINS shop.
Someday I'm gonna forge my own sword.
fix.Abyss beast hide never rots. Never softe: Hide from Abyss beasts never rots. Never goes soft, either.
fix.The training dummies down there take any: The training dummies down there can take anything you throw at them.
fix.This dog has followed me since I came ba: This dog's been following me ever since I got back from the woods.
fix.Careful at the portal. Not everything th: Be careful around the portal. Not everything that comes out of it is an animal.
fix.• The VENDOR trades fragments for fortun: • The VENDOR trades fragments for luck and bag space.
fix.• The BLACKSMITH (inside the forge) impr: • The BLACKSMITH (inside the forge) boosts your power and precision.
fix.• The SANCTUARY grants blessings that la: • The SANCTUARY gives you blessings that last forever.
fix.• The PORTAL leads to the endless Depths: • The PORTAL takes you into the endless Depths (Endless Mode).
fix.• Test your blows on the TRAINING DUMMIE: • Try out your moves on the TRAINING DUMMIES.
fix.• Wanted: whoever brings the Pale Dragon: • Wanted: anyone who can bring back the Pale Dragon's seal.
fix.The fire's warmth drives off the cold of: The warmth of the fire chases off the chill of the Depths.
fix.You take a deep breath. For a moment, al: You take a deep breath. For a moment, everything is calm.
fix.The embers crackle like distant footstep: The embers crackle like footsteps far away.
fix.Good steel needs patient fire. How can I: Good steel needs a patient fire. What can I do for you?
fix.Bring fragments and I'll make your blade: Bring me fragments and I'll make that blade fit for the Abyss.
10-hit combo! The dummy's begging for mercy.
fix.I'm Draven, son of King Valdrak. One day: I'm Draven, King Valdrak's son. One day I'll go back to my father's castle — and shut the gates he opened.
fix.You entered Valdrak Castle… did you see: You went into Valdrak Castle… did you see the throne? Thank you for bringing a little light back into my home.
fix.Akihiro, of Sakurajima. My katana was te: Akihiro, from Sakurajima. My katana was tempered in the ash of my home's volcano.
fix.You crossed the Ash Volcano. Now you und: You made it across the Ash Volcano. Now you know why my clan swore to guard those forges.
fix.Hayato. I trained the bow atop Sakurajim: Hayato. I learned the bow on top of Sakurajima, shooting into the ash wind. The air here's almost too calm.
fix.You faced the Pale Dragon? My arrows sti: You took on the Pale Dragon? Just thinking about that crater makes my arrows shake.
fix.Seris. I grew up among smugglers on the: Seris. I grew up with smugglers on the Isles — and I know what every secret costs.
fix.You went through the Isles. Saw the flag: You've been to the Isles. See the boats with no flags? That's Order of the Threshold money.
fix.Arthelia, of the Dal-Vor Academy, in the: Arthelia, from the Dal-Vor Academy out in the dunes of Ra-Khem. The temple mirrors taught me how to read light.
fix.You were in the Forgotten Desert. The te: You were in the Forgotten Desert. That temple was never a sanctuary… it was a cell. And you opened it.
fix.Tharion. The Ruins were once a sacred gr: Tharion. The Ruins used to be a sacred grove — I can still hear the roots under the marble.
fix.You walked the Ancient Ruins. The roots: You walked through the Ancient Ruins. The roots have been at peace ever since. Thank you.
fix.Araí. My grandparents' forest is sick, a: Araí. My grandparents' forest is sick, and I'm going to heal it, even if it takes my whole life.
fix.You freed the Anhangá. The spirits of th: You set the Anhangá free. The spirits of the Grove say your name kindly now.
fix.Valthor. The dead tell me secrets the li: Valthor. The dead tell me the secrets the living chose to forget.
fix.You crossed the Dead Forest. The whisper: You made it through the Dead Forest. The whispers have gone quiet… for now.
fix.Kael, of the frozen northern lands. My w: Kael, from the frozen north. My wolf misses the snow.
fix.You toppled the Ice Golem. The northern: You brought down the Ice Golem. The northern wolves are howling again — I could hear them from here.
fix.Psst! Fresh potions, straight from the c: Psst! Fresh potions, hot off the cauldron!
fix.Fresh herbs and a little magic. What do: Fresh herbs and a pinch of magic. What can I get you?
fix.I planted these flowers in Abyss soil. T: I grow these flowers in Abyss soil. Makes them heal better.
fix.The golden one protects, but it doesn't: The gold one keeps you safe, but it wears off fast. Pick your moment.
fix.The orange one kindles fury; the blue on: The orange one gets your blood boiling; the blue one tops your magic right back up.
fix.“Take as many as you need. The cauldron: “Take as many as you like. The cauldron never runs dry.”
Regular potion — goes straight into slot 1.
fix.A MECHANISM UNLOCKED A DOOR…: SOMEWHERE, A MECHANISM UNLOCKED A DOOR…
Heals three times as much as a regular potion.
You take no damage for 6 seconds.
fix.Common heal (+3 health plus Alchemy bonu: Basic heal (+3 health, plus your Alchemy bonus).
fix.The Herbalist only trades in the campaig: The Herbalist only does business in the campaign.
fix.THE RIFT REJECTED YOU! Returning to Refu: THE RIFT SPAT YOU OUT! Heading back to the Refuge...
fix.“First wake the middle one, that faces t: “First, wake the one in the middle, facing the trail.
fix.Then the western one, turned to the pine: Then the one to the west, looking out at the pine clearing.
fix.Last, the eastern one, that hears the fr: Last, the one to the east, listening to the frozen lake.”
Ice, light, iron and fire all shine at once.
fix.In the Icy Grove, the Reliquary's crysta: Over in the Icy Grove, the Reliquary's crystal starts to crack…
fix.A heart of ice beats trapped in the crys: A heart made of ice beats inside the crystal. Four sockets circle the pedestal.
fix.Cold as snow, yet it beats like a living: Cold as snow, but it beats like a living heart.
fix.The runes of the Frozen Gate will recogn: The runes on the Frozen Gate will know it.
All four runes are cold and dark.
fix.In the middle of the circle there is a h: In the middle of the circle there's a heart-shaped socket… covered in frost.
fix.Perhaps something in the forest outside: Maybe something out in the forest can wake them up.
fix.Do you want to enter the Challenge Rift: Want to go into the Challenge Rift now?
fix.A record of the creatures of Eldervale,: A record of the creatures of Eldervale, the dungeons beneath the seals and the Abyss itself. Written for those who go down — and for those who plan on coming back.
fix.Values in this book are base values: eli: The numbers in this book are base values — elites, enraged bosses and Endless Mode hit harder.
fix.A torn-out page… Only those who reach th: A page has been torn out… Only those who make it to the end of the journey will know what it said.
fix.“Only the right fire opens the way. Ligh: “Only the right fire opens the way. Light only:
Light the wrong one and they all go out.
Every seal lights up at once.
fix.All nine relics… no one has gathered the: All nine relics… nobody's gathered them since the first sealing. They're watching over you now.
fix.The blessing always applies, even unequi: The blessing always works, even when they're not equipped.
fix.Each relic's own effect only works when: Each relic's own effect only works while it's equipped.
fix.“Each land keeps a seal. Each seal, a pi: “Every land keeps a seal. And every seal, a piece
fix.of whoever first closed the Depths.”: of whoever first shut the Depths.”
SPY DOWN! The Observer just lost an eye.
fix.The spy is about to escape!: The spy's about to get away!
The spy got away — the Observer will hear about this...
fix.That voice on the river… it said it woul: That voice on the river… she said she'd be waiting for me. But who is she?
fix.I feel like someone is guiding me… or wa: I feel like someone's guiding me… or watching me.
fix.Voice… if you're out there, show yoursel: Hey… if you're out there, show yourself!
fix.Don't go near it. That was an eye of the: Stay away from it. That was one of the Observer's eyes.
fix.He spreads spies across every land. Even: He's got spies in every land. Even now, something could be watching us.
fix.Out there, in the lands beyond the gates: Out there, past the gates, they won't just watch — they'll attack. Take them down before they get away.
fix.That voice again… who are you, really?: That voice again… who are you, really?
fix.Wake, traveler. The river carried you fa: Wake up, traveler. The river's carried you farther than any boat should go.
fix.The forest remembers those who crossed b: The forest remembers everyone who came this way before you. Follow the current.
fix.These waters once marked the border of t: These waters used to mark the border of the Ancients. Not many dared to cross it.
fix.There, the shore. From here on, you walk: There — the shore. From here on, you walk.
fix.Listen to the forest. It is the last hon: Listen to the forest. It's the last honest voice you'll hear before the Depths.
fix.Another boat, another traveler. Not all: Another boat, another traveler. Not all of them made it to me.
fix.This statue watched the first sealing. S: This statue saw the first sealing. Soon you'll understand what it was guarding.
fix.Beyond the trees lies the Heart of the F: Past those trees is the Heart of the Forest. I'll be waiting for you there.
fix.Feel the wind. It carries the whispers o: Feel that wind? It carries the whispers of everyone these waters swallowed.
fix.This bridge once joined two kingdoms, un: This bridge used to join two kingdoms — until the darkness split its stones.
fix.The fireflies guide those who still have: The fireflies guide anyone who still has hope. Let them lead you to shore.
fix.Life still endures in these woods. Walk: There's still life in these woods. Go slow… the animals here haven't learned to fear the Depths yet.
fix.This lake reflects the sky from before t: This lake still reflects the sky from before the Depths. Hold on to this view when the darkness comes.
fix.These stones were an outpost of the seal: These stones were an outpost for the guardians of the seal. I knew every one of them… a long time ago.
fix.The birds suddenly went quiet. Even here: The birds just went quiet. Even out here, I can feel eyes on us. Follow the trail east.
fix.That voice… it seems to come from everyw: That voice… it's coming from everywhere at once.
fix.Show yourself! Why won't you appear?: Show yourself! Why are you hiding?
fix.The Heart of the Forest… so that's where: The Heart of the Forest… so that's where I'll find out who this voice belongs to.
fix.It's been so long since I've seen water: I haven't seen water this clear in a long time…

add.Você ousa me negar? Depois de tudo que f: You dare refuse me? After everything I've done for this kingdom?
add.Se ninguém vai salvar Aelric… então os s: If no one's going to save Aelric… then the seals are MINE.
add.Elyndra, não! Eles vão te consumir como: Elyndra, no! They'll eat you alive, just like they did to me!
add.Esta é a mata dos meus avós. Ela está do: This is my grandparents' forest. It's sick — I can feel it in the roots.
add.O Anhangá nunca fez mal a quem respeita: The Anhangá never hurt anyone who respected the forest. Something twisted it.
add.Descanse, Anhangá. Vou levar o seu selo: Rest now, Anhangá. I'll carry your seal far away from the darkness.
add.Os espíritos da mata sussurram o seu nom: The forest spirits whisper your name, Guardian. And not kindly.
add.O selo dorme debaixo da sumaúma. Ninguém: The seal sleeps under the kapok tree. Nobody cuts this tree down.
add.E se gente de fora vier procurar?: And if outsiders come looking for it?
add.O Anhangá confunde o caminho deles. A ma: Then the Anhangá leads them astray. The forest takes care of itself.
add.Dissemos que eram portas para lugares es: We said they were just doors to forgotten places.
add.Dissemos que os antigos foram destruídos: We said the Ancients were destroyed by the power they found.
add.Em Valdrak, um rei abriu as portas do ca: In Valdrak, a king opened the castle doors to save his people...
add.O que entrou... nunca mais saiu dos olho: Whatever came in... never left his eyes again.
add.O colapso rasgou o tecido das eras e dim: The collapse tore through eras and worlds... and now the Depths are waking up.
add.Convocados através de fendas de eras e d: Called through rifts from distant eras and worlds...
...some came looking for answers. Some came for revenge.
add.E alguns... porque os mortos pediram que: And some... because the dead asked them to.
add.Foram escolhidos porque já foram tocados: You were chosen because the Depths have already touched you.
add.Nas Profundezas Amazônicas, o Anhangá pr: In the Amazon Depths, the Anhangá protected the souls of the forest. Even corrupted, it fought to the very end.
add.Debaixo da maior sumaúma da mata, os paj: Beneath the biggest kapok tree in the forest, the shamans hid an ancient seal.
add.O Anhangá, protetor dos bichos e das alm: The Anhangá, protector of animals and souls, watched over the seal until the corruption twisted its shape.
